publishedExample.source: BPHS 46, notes to v. 16 (R. Santhanam tr.), Moon at Sagittarius 13 deg

note: Engine instants are unrounded milliseconds (startMs/endMs); its ISO strings round them to the millisecond, and vimshottariAt compares whole-millisecond instants with those rounded boundaries, as this tool does with the exact ones. An exact boundary within a few microseconds of a half millisecond can round the other way from the engine's; src/vedic/dasha.test.ts checks that each period's own ISO start and end find it.
